#!/bin/bash
# AMP launcher: private socket-only MySQL -> dbimport -> authserver (background) -> worldserver (console).
cd "$(dirname "$0")/azerothcore" || exit 1
base=$PWD sock=$PWD/run/mysqld.sock
export PATH="$base/mysql/bin:$PATH" LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$base/lib:$base/mysql/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
mkdir -p run lib server/logs
# Debian 13 / Ubuntu 24.04 renamed libaio.so.1; MySQL's generic build still links the old name.
for f in /usr/lib/*-linux-gnu/libaio.so.1t64; do [[ -e $f ]] && ln -sf "$f" lib/libaio.so.1; done
[[ -s .dbpass ]] || (umask 077; tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 </dev/urandom | head -c 24 > .dbpass)
export MYSQL_PWD=$(<.dbpass)

if [[ ! -d mysqldata/mysql ]]; then
    echo "[AMP] Initializing MySQL data directory"
    mysqld --no-defaults --initialize-insecure --basedir="$base/mysql" --datadir="$base/mysqldata" || exit 1
    fresh=1
fi
if ! mysqladmin --socket="$sock" ping &>/dev/null; then
    mysqld --no-defaults --basedir="$base/mysql" --datadir="$base/mysqldata" --socket="$sock" \
        --pid-file="$base/run/mysqld.pid" --skip-networking --mysqlx=OFF \
        --log-error="$base/server/logs/mysqld.log" &
    for _ in {1..60}; do mysqladmin --socket="$sock" ping &>/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
fi
sql() { mysql --socket="$sock" -uroot "$@"; }
[[ $fresh ]] && MYSQL_PWD= sql -e "ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '$MYSQL_PWD'"
stop() { kill $auth 2>/dev/null; mysqladmin --socket="$sock" -uroot shutdown 2>/dev/null; wait; exit "$1"; }
sql -e "SELECT 1" >/dev/null || { echo "[AMP] MySQL did not start, see server/logs/mysqld.log"; stop 1; }

db=".;$sock;root;$MYSQL_PWD"
export AC_LOGIN_DATABASE_INFO="$db;acore_auth" AC_WORLD_DATABASE_INFO="$db;acore_world" \
    AC_CHARACTER_DATABASE_INFO="$db;acore_characters" AC_DISABLE_INTERACTIVE=1
cd server/bin || stop 1
for c in ../etc/*.conf.dist ../etc/modules/*.conf.dist; do
    [[ -e $c && ! -e ${c%.dist} ]] && cp "$c" "${c%.dist}"
done
# Player login/logout lines drive AMP's user list.
grep -q '^Logger.entities.player=' ../etc/worldserver.conf || echo 'Logger.entities.player=4,Console Server' >> ../etc/worldserver.conf

echo "[AMP] Creating/updating databases (the first run takes several minutes)"
AC_UPDATES_ENABLE_DATABASES=7 stdbuf -oL ./dbimport || stop 1
# Realm list type icon follows GameType (FFA PvP shows as PvP).
icon=${AC_GAME_TYPE:-0}; [[ $icon == 16 ]] && icon=1
q() { sed "s/\\\\/\\\\\\\\/g; s/'/''/g" <<<"$1"; }
sql acore_auth -e "UPDATE realmlist SET name='$(q "$AMP_REALM_NAME")', address='$(q "$AMP_REALM_ADDRESS")', port=${AC_WORLD_SERVER_PORT:-8085}, icon=$icon WHERE id=1"

# Line-buffer output so AMP's console shows it live.
stdbuf -oL ./authserver & auth=$!
stdbuf -oL ./worldserver
stop $?
